title: Airbnb prepares an optional natural-language search experience
friendlyTitle: Airbnb will test a search box you can talk to naturally
summary: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky said the company will test an AI search mode that lets travellers describe what they want in natural language and receive visual results. A toggle will preserve the existing search and filters, while Airbnb says its support agent already completes about 45% of the cases it starts without a person.
friendlySummary: Airbnb plans to let people describe the kind of trip or place they want in normal language. Users can switch between the new AI search and the usual filters.
whyItMatters: Optional AI search is a sensible pattern for consumer products: people can use conversational discovery without losing familiar controls. The test will show whether natural-language intent produces genuinely better travel choices rather than merely a different interface.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This may make it easier to find a suitable place without changing many filters. Keeping the old search available gives people a clear choice.
